All audio processing happens on your phone; nothing is uploaded. Please only use content you have the rights to.
Takes a few seconds. Keep the app open.
Drag to choose any part of the song. Auto finds the busiest section (usually the chorus).
Apply it to your phone right after saving
To change the default ringtone, Android requires the \"Modify system settings\" permission. Enable it for Melodi Zil on the next screen and come back.
Ringtones you make are listed here. You can set, share or delete them.
\"%1$s\" will be permanently removed from your phone.

1. Only the audio stream of the video is downloaded to your phone (no video).

2. The audio is decoded on-device and the predominant melody (usually the vocal or lead instrument) is extracted note by note with spectral analysis. Lyrics disappear; only the tune remains.

3. The notes are re-synthesized on your phone with the form you choose (piano, music box, 8-bit…). Nothing is sent to any server.

4. The result is saved as WAV in the Ringtones folder and can be set as default ringtone, notification or alarm.

The downloaded original audio is deleted when processing ends; only your melody stays on the device.

Melodi Zil does not collect, store or share any personal data.

• No accounts, no sign-up, no analytics, no ad SDKs.
• The YouTube link you paste is sent only to YouTube's servers to fetch the audio stream. It is never sent to us or to any third party.
• All audio processing happens on your phone. The downloaded audio file is deleted after processing.
• Ringtones you create are saved to your phone's Ringtones/Notifications/Alarms folders and stay fully under your control.
• The "Modify system settings" permission is used only to set the default ringtone and is optional.

Content rights: make sure you have the right to use the content you download. Melodi Zil is not affiliated with YouTube.
